name: Imokoi Diary~ 2
source:
Sister-in-law comes over to watch after protagonist who lives alone, but her attitude is cold. But when he comes to her place, he hears suspicious sounds from sister's room. Being worried, he opens the door without knocking...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
嫂子来照顾独居的主人公，但态度十分冷淡。某天，主人公来到她家，听见姐姐房间里传出可疑的声音。他担心之下，没有敲门便打开了房门……

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
